<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Make Unisphere a coherent, SDK-first session exploration and query tool: discover repository-associated work, inspect sessions/turns/messages/tools/events, filter the intended evidence, extract useful context, and compute honest observed statistics. Every command is motivated by a user question, demonstrated with synthetic expected results, and taught by version-matched offline documentation. This is a product plan for nominated PM pij-empirical-tiger, not an implementation release. This is a substantial SDK upgrade, not a CLI-only wrapper. The SDK owns repository/source discovery, evidence-qualified session/turn/message/tool/event views, identity/lineage, filtering/time semantics, query-view freshness, context extraction, privacy-aware projection and observed aggregation through injectable public Rust APIs. The CLI parses arguments, composes providers and renders results; other SDK consumers receive the same behavior without invoking the CLI. Jordan will add more preamble directly with the PM; one context sentence and one question sentence per clarification turn, no implementation/fan-out until direction and guide review settle.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A user can find the right repository sessions without knowing each harness store layout, while seeing discovery and association gaps.
- A user can move from session identity to turns, messages, tool invocations and source events without contradictory counts or fabricated relationships.
- Shared identity/filter/time/privacy/output semantics make pipelines and SDK consumers predictable across commands and harnesses.
- Context-preserving extraction and tool timing/failure analysis answer practical review/debugging questions with explicit uncertainty.
- The installed binary teaches the workflows offline through docs list/get, schema discovery and tested examples; documentation is part of feature delivery.
- A future PM can decompose independent work against reviewed shared contracts, potentially across ten or more agents, without fragmenting the user experience.
- This is a substantial SDK upgrade, not a CLI-only wrapper. The SDK owns repository/source discovery, evidence-qualified session/turn/message/tool/event views, identity/lineage, filtering/time semantics, query-view freshness, context extraction, privacy-aware projection and observed aggregation through injectable public Rust APIs. The CLI parses arguments, composes providers and renders results; other SDK consumers receive the same behavior without invoking the CLI.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No product implementation/fan-out before the nominated PM pij-empirical-tiger completes Jordan's preamble and the reviewed guide boundaries; this workspace currently contains planning only.
- No duplicate implementation of plan014 Git-ai notes ingestion; integrate its actual contract without making all CLI work wait for that adapter.
- No retired harness telemetry reader, migration or compatibility path.
- No mandatory daemon, network collector, hosted database, model service or persistent index. A cache/index needs evidence and separate explicit design.
- No agent command execution/replay, source mutation/deletion/repair, annotation database, automatic prompt rewriting or model-generated summaries.
- No lossless/full-history/exactly-once claim, fabricated token cost, missing-duration zeroes, or causal cross-model performance ranking.
- No custom SQL/filter programming language; use typed flags, SDK APIs and structured output to existing tools.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Current CLI lists immediate JSONL files under an explicit leaf root and exports supported sources. A read-only local POC exercised native metadata discovery, a real external SDK listing bridge and filters: physical source rows exceeded distinct harness/native-ID pairs, metadata-only entries existed, and some sources could not be associated. This motivates explicit identity, coverage and time semantics, not promotion of the POC code. Public OpenTrace and Recensa READMEs were inspected for discovery/query design context; their claimed capabilities are not source-format authority or reused code. Flowspace3 docs runtime, indexed docs tests and static topic implementation were inspected; see assets/documentation-design.md. Internal ISE findings are not included.

<a id="risks-assumptions"></a>

## Risks & Assumptions

Source formats/identities/timestamps and turn/call boundaries vary and can be partial; copies/forks/cumulative counters can inflate aggregates; cross-store atomicity is not assumed. Resource bounds and view freshness need concrete guide mechanisms. CSV defaults to spreadsheet-safe encoding with explicit raw opt-in; output-mode selectors are mutually exclusive. Tiger owns canonical plan015 planning; Distro is a separate future-state synthesis, not a dependency. Reviewed architecture, exact Rust/schema/ID shapes and implementation proof remain future work. Recipe-led documentation is confirmed; companion skills remain a proposal whose packaging can be resolved in the guide without blocking planning.

## Implementation Summary

Baseline72d9d0cf remains independently approved/sealed. All nine first-wave Sol lanes delivered and their exact source union is preserved at843b3bb4. PM integration now passes327 workspace tests, clippy, rustdoc, and the actual17-crate architecture scan (86 edges;29 core/adapter source files). A real external SDK program exercised LocalQuerySource + ClaudeCodeAdapter + QueryService + ProjectedQueryWriter over temporary native JSONL, including measured tool statistics and private-payload omission; both SDK recipe binaries also execute. Corrections include context/statistics schema availability, branch forests, reserved ID filtering, native Cursor classification without telemetry intermediates, raw CSV preservation, bounded rendering, and explicit-path alias scope binding. First-wave full committed boot/review is being recorded; this is not new CLI acceptance. The tenth CLI lane remains formally unallocated due to a confirmed installed Builder dependency/composition cycle. A product-only manual helper has been offered to Jordan and is not assumed authorized.
